rules:
📜 PG Rules & Regulations:
1. Main gate closing time is 10:30 PM. Coordinate in advance if arriving late.
2. Visitors allowed only in common areas, must leave by 9:00 PM. No overnight stays without owner permission.
3. Keep rooms and bathrooms clean. Dispose garbage in designated bins.
4. No loud music or disturbance after 10:00 PM.
5. Smoking and alcohol consumption strictly prohibited inside premises.
6. Laundry schedule: Mon/Wed/Fri (each tenant gets 1 washing machine slot per week).
7. Two-wheeler parking available in basement. No four-wheeler parking.
8. Minimum notice period for vacating: 30 days.
9. Security deposit is non-refundable if vacating before 3 months.
